name: structural-ecoli
title: Structural E. coli
description:
Reconstructs a 3D structural view of the E. coli cell directly from a live
baseline whole-cell run, using the baseline_parsimony composite (baseline +
an EcoliPackStep that packs the molecular state at declared simulation times).
First study saves two snapshots — an initial state ~10 s in and a pre-division
state — for the Analysis Tools Parsimony Viewer.
question:
What does the whole-cell molecular state look like in real 3D space at key
points in the cell cycle — just after birth (post-equilibration) versus right
before division? Can we pack the simulated molecular counts into a 3D cell and
view declared-time snapshots in the Parsimony Viewer?

studies.name: s01-birth-and-division
studies.question:
Pack the simulated whole-cell molecular state into a 3D cell at ~10 s
(post-equilibration birth) and right before division, so the Parsimony Viewer
can show both declared-time snapshots for this study.
